summary: The bar that shows up when you search for text on the current page, usually opened with Ctrl+F.
description: The in-page find toolbar (Ctrl+F). A classic, template-string XUL widget with no JSDoc; builds its UI from anonymous-content markup addressed by anonid rather than shadow-DOM slots, and drives find state via a FindBar JSActor.

attributes.name: browserid
attributes.description: Read via getAttribute to resolve the associated <browser> the findbar operates on; set by embedding chrome.

attributes.name: prefillwithselection
attributes.description: Backs the prefillWithSelection JS property (getter returns getAttribute(...) != "false"); controls whether the find field is prefilled with the current selection.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Standard DOM property toggled by open()/close() to show or hide the bar.

attributes.name: noanim
attributes.description: Internal animation-suppression flag set during open()/close(), consumed by CSS.

events.name: find
events.description: Cancelable CustomEvent fired from _find() before executing a search; detail includes query, caseSensitive, matchDiacritics, entireWord, highlightAll, findPrevious.

events.name: findmatchescount
events.description: Cancelable CustomEvent fired from _updateMatchesCount() with the current match count in detail.

cssProperties.name: --findbar-border-top-width
cssProperties.description: Top border width of the findbar.

cssProperties.name: --findbar-container-height
cssProperties.description: Height of the findbar's inner container.

cssProperties.name: --findbar-height
cssProperties.description: Overall computed height of the findbar.
